service: settle inherited open draft assignments from already-accepted structured editorial judgments
preconditions: every automatic refusal names an accepted exact-manuscript editorial judgment whose failure layer is assignment, sources, or deterministic gates
recoverable work remains byte-preserved and receives active or deferred control state
at most one recoverable assignment is active after settlement
postconditions: structurally invalid assignments have append-only refused dispositions
other recoverable assignments are deferred rather than deleted
the settlement records the exact reused judgment digests and invokes no new inference
prohibitions: no conversion of a revise judgment into an accepted manuscript
